title: Mujadara
author: farag4m

step.title: Saute onions
step.text: Set the pressure cooker to Saute. Add olive oil and the sliced onions.

step.title: Brown onions
step.text: Cook the onions until deeply golden and caramelized, stirring regularly.

step.title: Remove onions
step.text: Remove most of the browned onions and set them aside. Leave a small amount in the pressure cooker.

step.title: Add lentils
step.text: Add 1 cup lentils to the pressure cooker.

step.title: Pressure cook lentils
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add rice
steps.text: Add 2 cups rinsed rice to the cooked lentils.

steps.title: Season rice
steps.text: Add the remaining salt, cumin, black pepper if desired, and a small drizzle of olive oil.

steps.title: Stir
steps.text: Stir the rice and lentils together once.

steps.title: Final pressure cook
steps.text: Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Natural release
steps.text: Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then release any remaining pressure.

steps.title: Add onions
steps.text: Add most of the reserved browned onions back to the cooked rice and lentils.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Gently fluff and mix everything together.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with the remaining browned onions on top.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. The pressure cooker's Saute function is used for the onions.
